pending_commit.commit_message: shill: Connection: Remove Request/ReleaseRouting This patch prepares te removal of Connection from PortalDetector and HttopRequest. Calls to Connection::RequestRouting and ::ReleaseRouting are moved from HttpRequest to Device. Since the latter knows when a full multi probe trial is finished, it can call RequestRouting and ReleaseRouting exactly once, which remove the need for ref counting the number of RequestRouting calls. Since there is no other user of these two methods, they are also removed from Connection. BUG=b:136710574 BUG=b:136710873 TEST=1) "FEATURE=test emerge-eve shill" passed. 2) manual captive portal connection tests with real portal networks. shill: Remove Connection from PortalDetector This patch removes Connection as a member variable in PortalDetector and instead makes Device and ConnectionDiagnostic pass either two lists of DNS addresses for IPv4 and IPv6, or a single list and an IP family to PortalDetector::StartAfterDelay when a portal detection trial is started. This prepares for making PortalDetector aware of layer 3 informations like DNS address list so that a single Trial can retry over different IP families on dual stack networks. Since the most likely place to pass the freshest layer 3 information is PortalDetector::StartAfterDelay(), this patch also consolidates into one function ::StartAfterDelay(), ::StartTrialAfterDelay(), and ::StartTrial(), and adds ::UpdateAttemptTime as well. This allows to avoid carrying the same arguments forward from one function to the next. common-mk: .gn: respect shebangs of scripts we run gn's default behavior for scripts to always use `python`. It doesn't matter if the target script has its own shebang or is a different language, gn will always run it through `python`. This causes us problems as we migrate things to Python 3 -- we set the shebang to run `python2` or `python3` explicitly, but gn still uses `python`. Lets use /usr/bin/env as a simple exec redirect. This will end up running all the scripts directly and letting the kernel parse the shebang of the script. dlcservice: Change install logic acceptance The |Install()| of DLC(s) must gracefully handle scenrios. When an |Install()| is called: - Empty DLC list NOT allowed. - Unsupported DLC in list NOT allowed. - Duplicate DLC in list NOT allowed. - Already installed DLC allowed. It is now valid to pass in an already installed DLC(s), so there can be cases for install passed in as a high level view: Q1) Only already installed DLC(s). Q2) Already installed DLC(s) + unsupported DLC(s). Q3) Already installed DLC(s) + supported DLC(s). Q4) Already installed DLC(s) + supported DLC(s) + not supported DLC(s). |InstallResult| sent out is consistent and simple throughout the process: A1) Within |Install()| the call to send out |InstallResult| will include all the root mount points. A2) No |InstallResult| is sent out as this |Install()| call itself will fail. A3) On success, within |StatusUpdateAdvancedSignal()| the |InstallResult| sent out should include all the root mount points. On failure to allocate space during |Install()| there will be no |InstallResult| sent out as this |Install()| call itself will fail. On failure to mount or |ImageLoader| failure, |InstallResult| will include the root mount points of the previously installed and mounted DLC(s), but the newly installed DLC(s) will all be deleted with there root mount points set to an empty string. |InstallResult|'s success will be false and the corresponding error code will be set. A4) No |InstallResult| is sent out as this |Install()| call itself will fail. BUG=chromium:988210 TEST=FEATURES="test" emerge-$BOARD dlcservice dlcservice-client TEST=tast run $TEST_IP platform.DLCService # current + chromium:1718832 + chromium:1749665 Change-Id: I96e24fb839735e502850fe48521c299c552bcada Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1717434 Tested-by: Jae Hoon Kim <kimjae@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Jae Hoon Kim <kimjae@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Amin Hassani <ahassani@chromium.org>

tast: Add parameterized test support to ListTests GTest supports value-parameterized test suites with the INSTANTIATE_TEST_SUITE_P macro [1]. When listing tests with --gtest_list_tests, the output contains the test's parameterized value [2]. For example, ./dawn_end2end_tests --gtest_list_tests VulkanImageWrappingValidationTests. SuccessfulImport/Vulkan # GetParam() = 1 MissingTextureDescriptor/Vulkan # GetParam() = 1 ... If we simply pass the entire line with the parameterization to --gtest_filter, the corresponding test is not found. This CL strips the parameterization from --gtest_list_tests output. [1] https://github.com/google/googletest/blob/master/googletest/include/gtest/gtest-param-test.h [2] https://github.com/google/googletest/blob/master/googletest/src/gtest.cc#L5593 BUG=chromium:993457 TEST=verified that it works when running dawn_end2end_tests Change-Id: I107941693c7ebc5f2d74908084ecffba731c998d Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1758599 Tested-by: Brian Ho <hob@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hidehiko Abe <hidehiko@chromium.org>
